Offgrid frontend dependencies (self-hosted; no runtime CDN requests)

exifr 7.1.3, full UMD build
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/exifr@7.1.3/dist/full.umd.js
MIT; copyright Mike Kovarik. See exifr-LICENSE.

Leaflet 1.9.4
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css
BSD-2-Clause; copyright Vladimir Agafonkin and CloudMade.
See leaflet-LICENSE. Offgrid uses vector circle markers, not the image markers.

Manrope variable Latin font, @fontsource-variable/manrope 5.1.0
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@fontsource-variable/manrope@5.1.0/files/manrope-latin-wght-normal.woff2
SIL Open Font License 1.1. See /assets/manrope-LICENSE.

Natural Earth 1:110m land, release 5.1.2
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nvkelso/natural-earth-vector/v5.1.2/geojson/ne_110m_land.geojson
Public domain: https://www.naturalearthdata.com/about/terms-of-use/
The local geographic overview is generalized and is not for navigation.
The inline emergency SVG is a schematic fallback, not a precise basemap.

Optional external street tiles:
https://tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png
Map data copyright OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL.
https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright
Only requested after the user explicitly enables Street map.

Research attribution:
Chiikabu Labs Chipoint v2; SigLIP2 / OpenCLIP; Meta DINOv3; OSV-5M.
